Round 2: re-read the #3883 sentence against TaskWorkspaceView.tsx. revealFocusedPane measures the room's [role=tablist] strips before the host's focus rAF and, in its own rAF, returns when they were all in view below .task-workspace > .detail-header and the focused tab still is; otherwise it scrolls the focused tab's group to the start with a one-scroll scroll-margin of the header height + 8px. Panes opened inside the room use WorkspacePaneHostTree's controller action (value={{ open: controller.open, focusExisting }}), not the wrapper. tests/task-answer-support.spec.ts pins both the reveal and the in-view no-scroll case (fault-injected).
